attributes.probed_form:
BASELINE (remeasured live): real 48, insns T116/O116, multiset 4t (target-only +1 b +1 bne, ours-only -1 beq -1 li), fuzzy 90.043106.

PROBE G1 (DISCARDED, NEUTRAL): named the memcpy source pointer at both call sites - `memcpy(dst, (u8*) lbl_80343C74 + 41416, 128);` -> `u8* src = (u8*) lbl_80343C74 + 41416;` declared after `dst` plus `memcpy(dst, src, 128);`. real 48 -> 48; the `addis` for the source pointer moved one slot earlier but the cluster did not close.

PROBE G2 (DISCARDED, NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL - object bytes unchanged): same as G1 with the `src` declaration placed BEFORE the `dst` declaration. The source text never reached the compiler's decision point, so declaration order between two pointer initializers is not a lever here. G1+G2 are two identical A/Bs and KILL the src-pointer-spelling axis.

PROBE G3a (REVERTED, REGRESSED): declaration order `u8* base; int success = 1; int bit = ...;` -> `u8* base; int bit = ...; int success = 1;`. real 48 -> 58.

PROBE G3b (KEPT, commit 69a9af3ce): `if (lbl_80343C78 & (1 << bit)) {` -> `if (lbl_80343C78 & (success << bit)) {`. real 48 -> 65 but multiset 4t -> 3t and FRESH fuzzy 90.043106 -> 92.715515.

PROBE G4 (REVERTED, REGRESSED, on top of G3b): one-case switch carrier for the branch pair - `if ((u8) beginSaveCacheTransaction() != 1) { success = 0; }` -> `switch ((u8) beginSaveCacheTransaction()) { case 1: break; default: success = 0; break; }`. real 65 -> 67, multiset 3t -> 5t: MWCC folded the carrier to `cmpwi r3,0`-style signed compare + `beq`, losing the target's `cmplwi r0,1` as well as failing to emit the pair.
attributes.residual:
RETAINED: real 65 (up from 48, an alignment artifact of losing the compensating extra instruction), insns T116/O115, multiset 3t, fuzzy 92.715515. TU fuzzy 95.682076 -> 95.784420.

WHY THE `success << bit` FORM WORKS, and it is a NEW lever worth generalizing: the target's prologue is `slwi r0,r27,2 / lis r4,base@ha / add r29,r28,r0 / li r30,1 / slw r0,r30,r29 / lwz r3,mask / addi r31,r4,base@lo / and.` - ONE `li r30,1` serving BOTH the shift operand and the initial value of the `success` flag. This TU compiles with `#pragma opt_common_subs off` over get_vmu_directory (lines 362-431) AND file-wide `#pragma opt_propagation off` (line 267), so MWCC cannot prove `1 << bit` equals `success << bit`; the sharing must be spelled in the SOURCE. Writing the flag variable as the shift operand emits exactly one `li` and closes the whole 5-row prologue cluster.

RECONSTRUCTION DEBT, stated plainly: `success << bit` where `success` is known to be 1 is a mild fakematch - semantically identical, but not obviously what a Midway developer wrote. It is retained as staged progress under the reconstruction-quality policy, not as a finished form. A future lane that finds the honest spelling (e.g. the original variable was a mask-builder that doubles as a status flag, and deserves a different name) should replace it and keep the codegen.

WHY real ROSE WHILE FUZZY ROSE TOO: at baseline the function held count parity 116/116 through TWO cancelling errors - our extra `li` and the target's extra branch. Closing the `li` leaves 115/116, and every subsequent instruction re-aligns, inflating the diff-line count. The opcode multiset (4t -> 3t) and fresh objdiff fuzzy (+2.67) both say the stream is strictly nearer. Banked via `defake_gate check game/sys/memcard --bank-arbitrated=get_vmu_directory` (the mandate-correct path for a fuzzy-arbitrated keep), so every sibling still gates against its original anchor.

REMAINING RESIDUAL, three items, all named:
(1) THE BRANCH PAIR @0x48: target `bne ->50 / b ->54`, ours `beq ->54`. Body is an ASSIGNMENT (`success = 0;`) and the branch target 0x54 is a JOIN block. Carriers now measured dead here: arm-swap (v1 record), one-case switch (G4), ternary (vetoed by law NV without a probe). See claim.law.LG_unfolded-two-edge-branch-terminator-is-source-shape-not-a-missing-flag.20260901.v1 - the shape is source-reachable (195 byte-exact functions carry it), so the carrier dictionary, not a flag, is the way in. NEXT UNTRIED HYPOTHESIS: the one carrier the corpus has never tried on this class is the cardDoMount idiom - an `if` whose body is a JUMP STATEMENT. Restructure so the guard's taken edge LEAVES the block (`if ((u8)beginSaveCacheTransaction() == 1) goto have_transaction;` with `success = 0;` falling through to the label) rather than assigning and falling through.
(2) THE TWO memcpy ADDRESS CLUSTERS @0x68-0x80 and @0xf4-0x10c (4 rows each): target forms the source pointer's `addis` immediately after its `lwz` into a FRESH register and puts the destination's `addis` into another fresh register (`addis r4,r3,1 / addis r6,r31,1`), whereas we self-update (`addis r4,r4,1` late). G1/G2 killed the pointer-naming axis; untried is forcing the two `addis`es adjacent by some other means.
(3) The r28/r29 swap through the name-normalizing loop (0x128-0x19c) is a consequence of (1)-(2), not an independent residual.
